No actionable correctness or security defect was found in the introduced changes; this maintainer-authored PR should remain open for normal landing. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `b401f47679e38d251eba8343121ef7edab4feed4` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | A focused recovery repair with meaningful cancellation, accounting, and retry-limit coverage and no blocking findings. | | **Proof confidence** | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Not applicable: The maintainer-authored PR is exempt from the external-contributor proof gate. Available coverage connects the real Responses parser to session recovery using deterministic fixtures; it does not establish live provider truncation. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Not applicable | Not applicable: The maintainer-authored PR is exempt from the external-contributor proof gate. Available coverage connects the real Responses parser to session recovery using deterministic fixtures; it does not establish live provider truncation. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 10 items | Pinned PR identity: The live REST response confirms the PR remains open and unmerged at the reviewed head, with base 867e655d51d892c47ee68fc7f02c7e8ca0a5628d. Review used the merge-base-to-head changes, not current-main endpoint drift.
Current main still needs the fix: Current main delegates exclusively to the generic retry classifier and removes a trailing assistant message; it lacks the output-limit-specific continuation path.
Latest release check: The retry owner at the supplied latest release, v2026.9.4, likewise lacks the new output-limit classification. No shipped replacement was established. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together OpenClaw’s built-in agent loop turns model responses into tool executions and recorded results. The session recovery owner uses those results to continue an interrupted task without replaying the original request. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Model response stream] --> B{Output limit interrupts a tool call?} B -->|Yes| C[Settle admitted tools] C --> D[Record results and terminal usage] D --> E{Cancelled or intentionally stopped?} E -->|Yes| F[End run] E -->|No| G[Bounded session retry] G --> A B -->|Other failure| F ``` ## Before merge None.

### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production versus regression coverage** | Production +51 net lines; tests +374 net lines | Production growth implements bounded recovery classification and settlement ordering; most growth protects failure-path behavior. | ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep bounded continuation in the session owner, preserving settled results, durable failure history, cancellation, and existing tool admission checks. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes, from source: an incomplete-tool terminal caused by max_output_tokens bypasses current main’s session retry classifier. The regression fixtures model that path; this review did not execute it. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes. Reusing session continuation preserves completed work without adding another retry owner or weakening the outer replay guard. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Not applicable: The maintainer-authored PR is exempt from the external-contributor proof gate. Available coverage connects the real Responses parser to session recovery using deterministic fixtures; it does not establish live provider truncation. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned PR identity:** The live REST response confirms the PR remains open and unmerged at the reviewed head, with base 867e655d51d892c47ee68fc7f02c7e8ca0a5628d. Review used the merge-base-to-head changes, not current-main endpoint drift. ([b401f47679e3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b401f47679e38d251eba8343121ef7edab4feed4)) - **Current main still needs the fix:** Current main delegates exclusively to the generic retry classifier and removes a trailing assistant message; it lacks the output-limit-specific continuation path. No shipped replacement was established. ([`src/agents/sessions/agent-session-execution.ts:32`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/3a9d69db306cd7f081e06254cb89c4bcc14a7107/src/agents/sessions/agent-session-execution.ts#L32), [3a9d69db306c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3a9d69db306cd7f081e06254cb89c4bcc14a7107)) - **Settlement and cancellation ordering:** Output-limit handling waits for admitted executions before recording the original usage-bearing terminal. External cancellation changes that terminal to aborted; unanimous tool termination prevents retry. Existing tool preparation and final source-start admission checks remain in place. ([`packages/agent-core/src/agent-stream-response.ts:368`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b401f47679e38d251eba8343121ef7edab4feed4/packages/agent-core/src/agent-stream-response.ts#L368), [b401f47679e3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b401f47679e38d251eba8343121ef7edab4feed4)) - **Recovery boundary and regression coverage:** The session tests exercise the real Responses parser with synthetic events and mocked model requests. They check retained results, no unfinished-call execution, retry exhaustion, cancellation, disabled retries, filtering, and intentional termination. This is OpenClaw’s own parser/session implementation; no Codex dependency contract is asserted. ([`src/agents/sessions/agent-session-responses-eof.test.ts:24`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b401f47679e38d251eba8343121ef7edab4feed4/src/agents/sessions/agent-session-responses-eof.test.ts#L24), [b401f47679e3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b401f47679e38d251eba8343121ef7edab4feed4)) - **Bounded diagnostic classification:** Continuation requires an error with incomplete_tool_call, a max_output_tokens incomplete terminal, and no provider-refusal diagnostic. The terminal producer retains only enumerated incomplete reasons, mapping unknown values to unknown. ([`packages/ai/src/providers/openai-responses-terminal-usage.ts:15`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b401f47679e38d251eba8343121ef7edab4feed4/packages/ai/src/providers/openai-responses-terminal-usage.ts#L15), [b401f47679e3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b401f47679e38d251eba8343121ef7edab4feed4)) Likely related people: - **unknown:** The claimed source-line change could not be verified from bounded local history.
